Statements & control flow

Statements and control flow: conditionals, loops, switch and match, guards, extraction, loop and function transfer, and the diagnostic statements.

Return to the grammar overview.

Formal grammar#

The rules for this part of the language are the parser's own definition of it. They are written for models and tools, so this page does not repeat them; the full list is at every production.
